parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: The name of the live stream application. The AppName you specify must be the same as the AppName of the live stream to be relayed for the configuration to take effect. You can view the AppName on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page.

parameters.name: DstUrl
parameters.description: The third-party streaming URL to which the stream is relayed.

parameters.name: StreamName
parameters.description: The name of the live stream. You can view the StreamName on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page.
